# Iron Cross Welding & Fabrication

> Custom welding and metal fabrication in Orange County, California. LA City and AWS D1.1 certified. Shop work and 24/7 mobile welding.

Iron Cross is a Christian-based welding and fabrication business serving Orange County and surrounding areas. Jobs are done in the shop or on site. There is no published street address.

Phone: (949) 329-3012
Text: sms:9493293012
Email: theironcrosswelding@gmail.com
Hours: Monday to Saturday, 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM
Emergency: 24/7 mobile dispatch
